title_block.title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 10
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 10 - View A. Includes Atomic Test Cases - N/A; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 10 - View B. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 56, 60, 65, 70, 78, 86, 93; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 10 - View C. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 51, 56, 63, 86, 91; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 10 - View D. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 79; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 10 - View E. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 63, 91
title_block.standard: ASME Y14.5M-1994 (dimensioning and tolerancing); ASME Y14.41-2003 (dataset and movable datum targets)

features.label: whole part
features.description: The part as a whole. General notes apply to all of it.

features.label: eight small holes in the pocket floor (8X)
features.description: Eight small round holes in the floor of the large rectangular pocket in the top face (view A). Flag 4 ties them to note 4: each must break into a cross-drilled hole.

features.label: top face
features.description: The large flat top face around the pocket (view A). It is datum feature A.

features.label: flat face beside the pin pads
features.description: Flat face next to the row of raised pin pads in view B, with a short supplemental line drawn on it to mark the line element the straightness control applies to.

features.label: narrow slot in the front face
features.description: Narrow vertical slot cut into the front face of the part, below the round boss (view B).

features.label: ⌀3.5 hole in the right pin pad
features.description: Small round hole in the top of the rightmost raised pin pad (view C). Its axis is datum feature E.

features.label: two M3 tapped holes in the first pin pad (2X)
features.description: The two M3 threaded holes in the first of the three pin pads, the top one in view D.

features.label: four cross-drilled holes (4X)
features.description: The four round holes drilled lengthwise through the scalloped lobes along one side of the part (view E).

values.meaning: Each of the eight pocket holes must be 2.5 mm in diameter plus or minus 0.15 mm, so between 2.35 and 2.65 mm; the flag 4 brings in note 4.
Flatness: every point of the top face must lie between two parallel planes 0.2 mm apart; no datum is used.
General note 6: all dimensions on the drawing are in millimetres.

values.applies_to: the line element drawn on the face; 0.2 over any 15 mm length
values.meaning: Straightness per unit length: along the marked line element, every 15 mm stretch must lie between two parallel lines 0.2 mm apart.
The slot width must be 5 mm plus or minus 0.2 mm, so between 4.8 and 5.2 mm.

values.applies_to: lower row of the frame stack under ⌀3.5 G6
values.meaning: Perpendicularity: the axis of the pin hole must lie in a 0.12 mm diameter cylinder exactly square to datum D.
Two metric threads, 3 mm nominal diameter, 0.5 mm pitch, tolerance class 6g.

values.applies_to: axis projected 3.2 mm out of each hole (projected tolerance zone)
values.meaning: Position with a projected tolerance zone: the axis of each M3 hole, projected 3.2 mm out of the hole, must lie in a 0.8 mm diameter cylinder at its true position from datums D, E and B.

Zero positional tolerance at maximum material condition: at the smallest hole size the axis must be exactly at true position from datums A, B and C; any extra hole size becomes the allowed position error.
Cylindricity: the surface of each cross hole must lie between two coaxial cylinders 0.1 mm apart (radially); no datum is used.
